notes:
E-Sys MAX 4.9.8

New
- E-Sys 26.04 supported: CAFD editor names and search, SVT names, full backup, Code several, FA write, fault scan, car report and flashing all work on 26.04.
- Dark (new): a sharper dark look for E-Sys, picked in the launcher, with a dark Windows title bar.
- Home: even garage tiles, a best-match hint and older versions folded away.

Fixed
- The CAFD (FDL) editor opens and shows setting names again on E-Sys 25.10.
- Full backup reads the whole car on one press again, and twin modules keep their own coding.
- German E-Sys: Full backup, the secure coding question, the automatic FA and SVT copies and the data-protection notice work when E-Sys is set to German.
- Car recovery: "Read the car now" follows the car that is connected now.
- Light look: car tiles keep the car's real paint colour.
- Dark look on E-Sys 22.06 to 24.06: toolbar buttons, status bar texts, side bar buttons and lists can all be seen again.

Changes
- The free trial is its own app now: E-Sys MAX Trial. The full E-Sys MAX is for bought licences.
- Your calculation strategy (Single Flash) is picked on every page that offers it, also in Comfort Mode.
- Flash assistant: when E-Sys wants the TAL saved before Execute, the assistant opens E-Sys's Save first.
- The job report and the car report also list flashes of a TAL saved under your own name; a flash finished with warnings while fitting or removing parts shows as done.
- Save and code reads E-Sys's result faster on E-Sys 25.10 and 26.04.
- Updates are checked more strictly before they install.
- Stronger protection under the hood.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
